definitions.explanation: A work arrangement where employees perform their duties from home rather than commuting to an office. Became widespread in Japan during the COVID-19 pandemic.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}は{在宅|ざいたく}ワークだ。
{在宅|ざいたく}ワークが{増|ふ}えて、{通勤|つうきん}しなくなった。
examples.english: Remote work has increased, and I've stopped commuting.

examples.japanese: {在宅|ざいたく}ワークでは{自己|じこ}{管理|かんり}が{大切|たいせつ}だと{言|い}われている。
examples.english: It's said that self-management is important when working from home.

notes:
USAGE:
Became an everyday term in Japan from 2020 onward. Used both as a noun and with する. Often abbreviated in casual speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {在宅|ざいたく}ワークをする (to work from home)
- {在宅|ざいたく}ワークに{切|き}り{替|か}える (to switch to remote work)
- {在宅|ざいたく}ワーク{環境|かんきょう} (work-from-home environment)
- {在宅|ざいたく}ワーク{手当|てあて} (remote work allowance)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- テレワーク: telework — a broader term covering any remote work, not only from home
- リモートワーク: remote work — essentially synonymous, slightly more casual
